description: Change an existing form without recreating it: edit its fields, settings (redirect, thank-you, title), or branding (theme/colors/logo), or close/reopen it. If you pass `fields`, provide the COMPLETE desired list — include each existing field's `id` (from get_form) to keep it; omit a field to remove it; leave `id` off a new field. If the form is already published, edits are re-published so they go live.

fields.description: Complete desired field list (see note); create_form shape plus an optional `id`.

id.description: Existing field id to keep/update; omit if new.

max_label.description: scale only: label under the top value

min_label.description: scale only: label under the lowest value

nps.description: Net Promoter Score preset (0–10, standard labels).

options.description: Choices for select/radio/checkbox/ranking; {label, image} objects for image_choice.

show_when.description: Conditional logic: show this field only while its conditions match EARLIER answers (e.g. a follow-up question, or a statement recommending a product). Omit to always show.

action.description: 'show' (default): shown only while the rules match. 'require': always shown, required only while they match. On a page_break field the rules skip the whole page.

field.description: The question this condition looks at: its label, its id, or its 0-based position.

op.description: eq / neq (is, is not), contains / not_contains (text or checkbox), gt / lt (numbers, ratings, dates), is_empty / not_empty (no value needed).

value.description: Value to compare with (an option's value for choice questions).

logo_url.description: URL of a logo image (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP) to show on the form.

outcomes.description: Pathways / branching endings. After submit the first outcome whose rules match decides the ending: its own thank-you title/message and/or a redirect_url (e.g. send people to a different product page per answer). If none match, the default thank-you page is shown.

end_early.description: Screening: end the form as soon as this matches (checked on every page change), not just at submit.

name.description: Short name, recorded on each response (e.g. 'Recommend Zero Sugar').

redirect_url.description: Optional page to send the respondent to.

field.description: The question this condition looks at: its label, its id, or its 0-based position.

op.description: eq / neq (is, is not), contains / not_contains (text or checkbox), gt / lt (numbers, ratings, dates), is_empty / not_empty (no value needed).

value.description: Value to compare with (an option's value for choice questions).

redirect_url.description: URL to send respondents to after they submit.

status.description: Close (stop responses) or reopen. When set, other edits are ignored.

theme.description: Named color preset. Explicit colors below override it.

name: update_form
